subject: English
passage: Miguel Hernández (1910–1942), also known as the "Poet of Goats," was a significant Spanish writer and playwright. His passionate verses ______ the struggles of rural life during the Spanish Civil War.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is punctuation use between a verb and an object. No punctuation is needed between the verb "depicted" and its object "the struggles of rural life." The object helps complete the idea of the verb—in this case, it explains what Miguel Hernández depicted—and any punctuation between the two results in an ungrammatical sentence.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect because no punctuation is needed between the verb and its object.
